title: A Mathematical Theory of the Jacobian Lens
abstract: arXiv:2610.31955v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work from Anthropic introduced a new interpretability tool, called the Jacobian lens (J-lens, Gurnee et al., 2026). This method identified linear directions in the hidden states of frontier language models that had properties reminiscent of working memory-like representations. However, it is unclear what mechanistic properties of such features make them detectable to the J-lens. To this end, we introduce a mathematical theory of the J-lens, and show that it preferentially identifies coherent features -- directions that act like leading, spatially coherent Lyapunov modes. Small perturbations along these directions amplify across layers, remain roughly constant across token positions, and are consistent across different contexts. translated_title: 雅可比透镜的数学理论
translated_abstract: Anthropic 最近的工作引入了一种新的可解释性工具，称为雅可比透镜（Jacobian lens，J-lens，Gurnee 等人，2026）。该方法在前沿语言模型的隐藏状态中识别出一些线性方向，其性质令人联想到工作记忆式的表征。然而，目前尚不清楚这些特征的哪些机制性质使得它们能够被 J-lens 检测到。为此，我们提出了 J-lens 的数学理论，并证明它优先识别的是“相干特征”——即表现得像主导的、空间相干的 Lyapunov 模态那样的方向。沿这些方向的小扰动会跨层放大，在不同词元位置之间大致保持恒定，并在不同上下文中保持一致。尽管我们对这些性质是否必然与“全局工作空间”相关联持不可知态度，但通过解析推导出的 J-lens 偏好仍然解释了先前应用于……的实证结果。
tldr: 本文提出了雅可比透镜（J-lens）的数学理论，证明该可解释性工具优先识别的是相干特征——即类似主导 Lyapunov 模态、可跨层放大、跨词元位置恒定且跨上下文一致的线性方向。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a mathematical theory of the Jacobian lens (J-lens), showing that it preferentially detects coherent features—directions that act like leading, spatially coherent Lyapunov modes, which amplify across layers, remain constant across token positions, and stay consistent across contexts.
